label: PF Backlog 550
title: EPIC: Make CI green - pre-existing build-breakage cleanup (deps, id-authority, cross-platform, generated artifacts, tests)
body:
## Problem / why
The `structure` CI job has failed on EVERY recent develop push. PR #16 (BI-PF-1225) fixed the first
blocker (py3.11 f-string) and added a guard, then revealed several more PRE-EXISTING failures unrelated to
that change. Until these are fixed, CI is not a functioning gate and no PR can go green.

## Goal & value
A green, trustworthy `structure` CI check so PRs merge normally (no override), and "green locally" ==
"green in CI".

## In scope
CI environment parity (deps + interpreter semantics), CI-safe id allocation, cross-platform code,
regenerate committed derived artifacts, and triage residual test failures.

## Out of scope
New features; the legacy-dashboard exclusion (BI-PF-1223) and the py3.11 guard (BI-PF-1225).
